scores.key_signal: Chevron's record US upstream production of 2.1 million BOE/day combined with accelerating capital efficiency and $3B in structural cost reductions signals structural supply growth that is deflationary for oil prices and oilfield services demand.
scores.name: Chevron Corp.

scores.key_signal: A geopolitical supply shock destroying ~20-25% of Middle East polyethylene capacity drove record contract price increases and a 4x year-over-year surge in LYB's Americas O&P EBITDA, representing a structural multi-quarter tightening in global petrochemical markets rather than a demand-driven recovery.
scores.name: LyondellBasell Industries NV

scores.key_signal: Volume-driven organic sales growth of 5.8% against a 3% outlook, with full-year guidance raised, signals resilient consumer staples demand even as intensifying competitive promotional activity in laundry reflects underlying consumer income pressure.
scores.name: Church & Dwight Co., Inc.

scores.key_signal: FERC's transmission ROE cut to 9.57% is structurally impairing Eversource's highest-returning segment, creating a material earnings headwind until at least November 2026, even as balance sheet repair via the $1.7B Aquarion sale reduces near-term financial risk.
scores.name: Eversource Energy

scores.key_signal: Moderna's revenue base remains structurally constrained at ~$145M/quarter with ~$600M quarterly cash burn, making the company entirely dependent on a successful 2026/2027 COVID/flu vaccination season and pending flu vaccine approval for any meaningful commercial recovery.
scores.name: Moderna, Inc.

scores.key_signal: EIX reaffirmed full-year EPS guidance with strong year-over-year core earnings growth, but California wildfire liability legislation remains the critical unresolved macro risk that could force capital plan reassessment and raise financing costs across the state's utility, municipal, and insurance sectors.
scores.name: Edison International

scores.key_signal: DexCom raised full-year guidance to 11-13% growth while achieving ~590bps operating margin expansion and over $600M in H1 free cash flow, signaling a durable operating leverage inflection in the CGM market with structural demand catalysts from expanding insurance coverage for Type 2 non-insulin diabetics.
scores.name: DexCom, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Dominion's Virginia service territory is experiencing historic electricity demand from AI/data center buildout, with 53 GW in contracting pipeline and nine all-time peak days in 2026, signaling a structural step-change in utility load growth.
scores.name: Dominion Energy, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Eaton's 307 GW US data center backlog representing 15 years of demand at 2025 build rates, combined with broad-based mid-to-high teens order growth across commercial, utility, and industrial end markets, signals a durable multi-year industrial capex supercycle well beyond AI infrastructure concentration.
scores.name: Eaton Corp. Plc

scores.key_signal: Record $28.6B institutional pipeline and $18.4B in long-term net inflows across every asset class and geography simultaneously signals broad-based institutional risk-on capital deployment, a strong leading indicator of expansionary financial conditions.
scores.name: Franklin Resources, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Alliant Energy's execution of five large electric service agreements driving a 60% demand increase by 2031, anchored by AI data center buildout from Google, QTS, and Meta, represents a transformational and durable demand catalyst for a regulated utility.
scores.name: Alliant Energy Corp.

scores.key_signal: Linde's record $8.1B sale-of-gas backlog, driven by advanced-node semiconductor electronics wins, signals durable private-sector industrial capex momentum even as Strait of Hormuz disruptions create meaningful Asia-Pacific supply chain headwinds extending into early 2027.
scores.name: Linde Plc

scores.key_signal: Emerging markets (India, Brazil, Mexico, China) are carrying organic growth mid-single-digits while the US business underperforms, reflecting a bifurcated global demand environment with domestic consumer stress offsetting international resilience.
scores.name: Colgate-Palmolive Co.

scores.key_signal: Structural active equity outflows of $6.5B continue with H2 expected to be 'meaningfully more challenging,' while accelerating fee rate compression to 38.1 bps signals persistent margin headwinds despite AUM recovery to $1.9T.
scores.name: T. Rowe Price Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: AJG's proprietary exposure unit data (payroll, headcount, fleet counts) remained positive through July 2026, providing real-time confirmation that US business activity is still expanding despite macro uncertainty, though rate tailwinds are fading with only ~1 point of 6% organic growth now rate-driven.
scores.name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.

scores.key_signal: MPS raised its Enterprise Data full-year growth floor from 85% to 130% YoY and extended capacity targets well beyond $6B, signaling that AI infrastructure buildout is driving exceptionally durable and broad-based semiconductor demand with no signs of inventory buildup.
scores.name: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Stryker's record Mako installations, elevated capital backlog, and 9% organic growth against a tough comp — with management citing production capacity rather than demand as the binding constraint — signals durable, structurally-driven hospital capital spending that contradicts broader CapEx caution narratives.
scores.name: Stryker Corp.

scores.key_signal: Ameren's execution of 2.8 GW in hyperscaler ESAs with Google and Amazon signals a structural inflection in utility demand, driving 60% projected electricity sales growth by 2029 and a $71B+ capex pipeline that represents one of the most significant regulated utility growth cycles in decades.
scores.name: Ameren Corp.

scores.key_signal: Corteva raised full-year EBITDA guidance ~9% at midpoint driven by cost productivity and technology adoption, but persistent low-single-digit crop protection pricing declines signal ongoing deflationary pressure in ag inputs that extends across the sector.
scores.name: Corteva, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Record comparable leasing volume of 819,000 sq ft at +15% cash rent spreads, driven by structural zero-new-supply dynamics in premium coastal retail markets, signals durable pricing power and robust forward NOI growth.
scores.name: Federal Realty Investment Trust

scores.key_signal: Record derivatives revenue (+30% YoY) driven by SPX options volume surge and regulatory deregulation (PDT rule repeal) is accelerating retail participation in complex instruments, signaling a structural expansion in financial market activity.
scores.name: Cboe Global Markets, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Management explicitly expects no improvement in auto, building & construction, and consumer durables for H2 2026, signaling a prolonged contraction in cyclical end markets despite Eastman's own execution holding up through pricing discipline and innovation-driven share gains.
scores.name: Eastman Chemical Co.

scores.key_signal: AWS accelerating to 36.7% YoY growth with a $496B backlog growing triple digits and $220B CapEx commitment signals a structural AI infrastructure supercycle reshaping enterprise IT capital allocation for years ahead.
scores.name: Amazon.com, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Skyrizi and Rinvoq combined revenues of ~$8B growing 24% and 23.7% respectively, with raised full-year guidance, confirm that next-generation biologics are fully absorbing Humira biosimilar erosion and sustaining double-digit top-line growth for AbbVie.
scores.name: AbbVie, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Organic orders accelerated to double-digit growth in early July across all major regions after long-cycle project delays, signaling a potential inflection in industrial capex — but margin compression from China pricing headwinds flags a persistent deflationary risk for multinationals with Asia exposure.
scores.name: Ingersoll Rand, Inc.

scores.key_signal: China delivering 9% organic growth led by industrial capex in new energy and biopharma signals a meaningful re-acceleration of EM industrial demand, with management guiding high-single-digit China growth through year-end.
scores.name: Mettler-Toledo International, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Fan counts up 10%+ across all venue types, geographies, and genres with historic-low cancellation rates signals structurally elevated experiential consumer spending heading into a record full year.
scores.name: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.

scores.key_signal: First Solar's gross margin surged ~1,200 bps YoY to ~57%, driven by IEEPA tariff benefits and Section 45X domestic manufacturing credits, but ~1.8 GW of international capacity remains stranded pending Section 232 policy resolution, illustrating how deeply U.S. trade policy now determines solar industry profitability.
scores.name: First Solar, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Mohawk's Q3 guidance of $2.50-$2.60 adjusted EPS (vs $3.67 in Q2) signals accelerating input cost inflation flowing through inventory into margins against a backdrop of structurally depressed housing demand across most geographies.
scores.name: Mohawk Industries, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Sunbelt multifamily supply overhang is rapidly absorbing, with blended lease rate growth turning from -1.6% to -0.2% sequentially and new lease rates turning system-wide positive in July for the first time in years, signaling a cyclical inflection point for apartment landlords.
scores.name: Camden Property Trust

scores.key_signal: Weyerhaeuser's characterization of housing activity as 'stuck in second gear' with OSB in a loss position signals that residential construction demand remains structurally weak, posing a headwind to the broader lumber and building materials supply chain.
scores.name: Weyerhaeuser Co.

scores.key_signal: Apple's 16% YoY revenue surge to a June quarter record $109.4B with double-digit growth across every geographic segment signals robust premium consumer and enterprise demand globally, though significant supply constraints and non-recurring tariff refund tailwinds (~2pp margin benefit) temper the underlying operational picture.
scores.name: Apple, Inc.
